blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Notification Center (visionOS 2.x / 26): Centered frosted glass stack over live passthrough world. One header 'Notifications' 22/-0.03 SF Pro Display 800 + subtle count pill, single group labels 'Earlier Today' 11/700 0.14em uppercase ink-60 with hairline divider only, no literal 'priority'/'tabular' tokens. Each banner is 18r glass (saturate 1.6 blur 28-34 + rim light + 2-layer depth shadow 40/90), 36px app icon with thin stroked glyph, title 15/600 ink-100, subtitle 13/400 ink-80 2-line clamp with 1.38 leading, time 11 tabular ink-60 right-aligned, inline actions muted until expanded (single primary gradient only on focus). Stack shows 2-3 banners peeking with depth scale 0.96 + blur falloff, single focal banner at a time (others dim to 0.42, focused scales 1.02 + 2.5px stroke-focus bloom 22px). Motion 260ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) interruptible spring, dismiss is interruptible swipe with rubber-band + veil, reduced-motion collapses to crossfade 160ms. No dev chrome inside 600x600, statusbar only time + battery + Focus glyph.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS notifications (Quest 3 v74 / Horizon Home feed): Flat opaque panels (rgba 36,36,36 0.98, 1px #333 border, no backdrop-filter, shadow 8px) full-width vertical list, date chips 'Today'/'Earlier' 12/600 on dark grey header bar with 3-dots overflow. Cards 12r, icon 24px flat tint, title 14 medium, body 12 regular, time 12 tabular but no optical hierarchy (3 equal weights), 2-3 equal CTAs per card (Reply/Open/Dismiss) all grey flat, no primary hierarchy, weak 1px blue focus ring competing across multiple cards. Motion linear 350-450ms slide with 20px overshoot bounce, janky blur none, no interrupt. Empty is centered text 'No notifications' 16/600 with no illustration, loading is three grey shimmer bars no skeleton depth, error is red text 'Failed to load' with plain Retry, offline shows snackbar 'No internet' overlapping list, permission is system dialog opaque. No undo, no glass, no delight beyond flat.

biggestGap: Typography + Glanceability — leaked token strings and hierarchy pollution: expected visionOS clean optical hierarchy (3 sizes max per card, SF Pro 22/14/13/11 tabular, no dev tokens visible, subtitle reads '3 now · 2 earlier · 10:36 AM', group head reads 'Now 3' + hairline only). Got components/05-notifications/index.html:569-571 subtitle.innerHTML `${nowCount} now · ${earlierCount} earlier · tabular` + `tabular ${time}` rendering as '3 now · 2 earlier · tabular tabular 10:37 AM' duplicate literal visible in reviews/probe-05-notifications-main/stage-normal.png top 46-68px; :621 group head `priority` leaks literal 'priority' next to divider; :682 preview detail 'Tab View ... tabular 12 MP' leaks token again. Distinct stage font sizes = 7 (10,11,12,13,14,16,22) vs spec 3 per card, hintbar crams 'Swipe ←→ dismiss Tap expand · Esc top Hey Prism' 3 instructions 10px/0.06em competing with header. VisionOS would never ship literal variable names; this instantly breaks <1s glanceability and typography trust. Fix: remove all literal 'tabular'/'priority' strings, keep only time/group counts tabular via font-variant-numeric, limit hintbar to one phrase, retain 3-size hierarchy per card.
